verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents a first-party Payment Links product as 'the easiest way for you to accept payments online without a digital storefront.' Its invoicing docs also describe generating digital payment links that support 160+ local payment methods, which covers the core of a shareable link for selling without building a site. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that links can be created from the dashboard with no code, evidence that a founder can start selling immediately (onboarding or activation speed), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
